Palette: Burnished gold-leaf sky, deep reds, ultramarine, ochres and earth greens.
Lighting: No cast shadows; inner light shown through layered highlights and gold glow.
Materials and texture: Egg tempera and gold-leaf texture within the scene.
Composition: Hieratic, balanced staging; the key subject largest and central; stylized rocks, buildings and trees.
